sentences.ar: بالمدرسة، توم وصل متأخر، لأنه وقف يحكي مع هَك.
sentences.en: At school, Tom arrived late, because he had stopped to talk with Huck.
The teacher said: Tom Sawyer!
Why are you late?

sentences.ar: توم كان رح يكذب، بس شاف إشي.
sentences.en: Tom was about to lie, but he saw something.
The girl with the yellow hair, sitting.

sentences.ar: وجنبها المكان الوحيد الفاضي بصف البنات.
sentences.en: And beside her the only empty seat on the girls' side.

sentences.ar: فقال: وقفت أحكي مع هَك فِن.
sentences.en: So he said: I stopped to talk with Huck Finn.
The teacher could not believe his ears.

sentences.ar: ضربه بالعصا، وقال: روح اقعد مع البنات!
sentences.en: He beat him with the stick, and said: go and sit with the girls!

sentences.ar: وهاد بالضبط اللي كان توم بده ياه.
sentences.en: And that was exactly what Tom wanted.

sentences.ar: قعد جنبها، وهي بعدت عنه، وحطت راسها بالكتاب.
sentences.en: He sat beside her, and she moved away from him, and put her head in her book.
Tom put a peach in front of her.
She pushed it away.
He put it back.
She pushed it away, but slower.
He put it back.
She took it.

sentences.ar: وبعدين رسم على اللوح بيت، وهي تطلعت.
sentences.en: And then he drew a house on his slate, and she looked.
She whispered: draw a man.
He drew a man taller than the house.
She whispered: pretty.
And draw me.

sentences.ar: رسم دايرة، وفيها عصيتين، واسمها بيكي، وكانت مبسوطة.
sentences.en: He drew a circle, with two sticks, and her name Becky, and she was pleased.

sentences.ar: وبعدين كتب توم على اللوح إشي، وغطاه بإيده.
sentences.en: And then Tom wrote something on the slate, and covered it with his hand.
She said: show me.
He said: no.
She said: show me, I will not tell anyone.
He lifted his hand, and it said: I love you.

sentences.ar: ضربته على إيده، واحمر وجهها، بس كانت مبسوطة.
sentences.en: She slapped his hand, and her face went red, but she was pleased.

sentences.ar: وبهاللحظة، إيد كبيرة مسكت توم من أذنه.
sentences.en: And in that moment, a big hand took Tom by the ear.
And lifted him, and took him back to his place.
The teacher.

sentences.ar: عالغدا، توم وبيكي التقوا ورا المدرسة.
sentences.en: At lunch, Tom and Becky met behind the school.
Tom said: Becky, do you like rats?
She said: no!
I hate them!
He said: live ones, I mean.
Dead ones, that you swing on a string.
She said: I like chewing gum better.
And he took out gum, and they shared it, chewing it in turns.
And Tom said: Becky, do you want us to be engaged?
She said: what does that mean?

sentences.ar: قال: يعني بتقولي لي إنك بتحبيني، وبنبوس بعض، وخلص.
sentences.en: He said: it means you tell me you love me, and we kiss, and that is it.
You marry no one but me.
And she whispered I love you, and he kissed her, and they were engaged.
